prompts.deadPrompt: Create a premium, anatomically accurate exercise instruction image for an Android app. Two equal panels horizontally, no text, no labels, no arrows. Same fictional adult man in both panels, short dark hair, sage green fitted T-shirt, charcoal shorts, barefoot, on muted mint yoga mat in warm off-white studio, soft natural light, crisp realistic educational photography, clean understated visual style. Full body completely in frame. Exercise: DEAD BUG, supine, head supported on mat, neutral neck and stable ribs/pelvis, no arched lower back. Camera high three-quarter side view revealing both arms and both legs distinctly. LEFT panel start: lying on back, BOTH straight arms vertical above shoulders, BOTH thighs vertical above hips, BOTH knees bent 90 degrees, shins horizontal. RIGHT panel end: same man stays supine; LEFT arm reaches backward overhead toward floor behind head and RIGHT leg extends forward away from hips nearly straight hovering comfortably above floor; RIGHT arm remains straight vertical above shoulder and LEFT thigh remains vertical with LEFT knee bent 90 degrees. Clearly separate near and far limbs, avoid confusing occlusion. Modest controlled range, extended heel about 20 cm above floor. Wide composition, each panel has enough room around the complete body.
